cohort: The study included 714 infants born before 32 weeks of gestation between 1 July 2017 and 31 December 2020 in the Erasmus MC Sophia Children's Hospital, excluding those who died within 24 hours after birth or with no glucose data available.
finding: 19% of very preterm infants experienced at least one episode of hypoglycemia in the first 24 hours of life, with significant risk factors identified including maternal insulin-dependent diabetes, antenatal steroid administration, no IV-access in the delivery room, lower gestational age, small-for-gestational-age, and no respiratory support.
